say:2:1230126002:1.text: The Carmine Whispers said it was all credit to someone called Merlin, but who's that? It's not like we have a statue of him in town.
say:2:1230126002:1.source_cn: 血薇帮说是一个叫梅林的人，但谁知道梅林到底是谁呢，城里...
say:2:1230126002:1.male: The Carmine Whispers said it was all credit to someone called Merlin, but who's that? It's not like we have a statue of him in town.
say:2:1230126002:1.female: The Carmine Whispers said it was all credit to someone called Merlin, but who's that? It's not like we have a statue of her in town.

say:3:1230126003:1.text: Let me get this straight—Merlin or not, I won't give you any discounts! Respect is one thing, but business is business!
say:3:1230126003:1.source_cn: 先说好，不管你到底是不是那个叫梅林的——我可不会打折！...
say:3:1230126003:1.male: Let me get this straight—Merlin or not, I won't give you any discounts! Respect is one thing, but business is business!
say:3:1230126003:1.female: Let me get this straight—Merlin or not, I won't give you any discounts! Respect is one thing, but business is business!
